```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(mice)

options(scipen = 999)

# Final diagnostics for the production MICE run.
# This script does not rerun or alter imputations.

IMP_PATH <- here("data", "derived", "mice_imp_final.rds")
INPUT_PATH <- here("data", "derived", "mice_input_final.rds")

stopifnot(
  file.exists(IMP_PATH),
  file.exists(INPUT_PATH)
)

imp <- readRDS(IMP_PATH)
dat <- readRDS(INPUT_PATH)

cat("Loaded final MICE object.\n")
cat("Rows:", nrow(dat), "\n")
cat("Imputations:", imp$m, "\n")
cat("Iterations:", imp$iteration, "\n")
```

## 1. Basic integrity

```{r}
expected_n <- 1602L
expected_m <- 20L
expected_iterations <- 20L

stopifnot(
  inherits(imp, "mids"),
  nrow(dat) == expected_n,
  imp$m == expected_m,
  imp$iteration == expected_iterations,
  identical(names(dat), names(imp$data))
)

if (is.null(imp$loggedEvents)) {
  cat("Logged events: 0\n")
} else {
  cat("Logged events:", nrow(imp$loggedEvents), "\n")
  print(imp$loggedEvents)
}
```

## 2. Confirm missingness and imputation counts

```{r}
target_vars <- c(
  "hinc",
  "hgowner",
  "smallspace",
  "livedhere",
  "east",
  "M_edu_level",
  "F_edu_level"
)

count_check <- tibble(
  variable = target_vars,
  n_missing_original = map_int(
    target_vars,
    ~ sum(is.na(dat[[.x]]))
  ),
  n_imputed_per_dataset = map_int(
    target_vars,
    ~ nrow(imp$imp[[.x]])
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    matches = n_missing_original == n_imputed_per_dataset
  )

print(count_check)

stopifnot(all(count_check$matches))
```

## 3. Completed datasets: no remaining missingness

```{r}
completed_list <- complete(
  imp,
  action = "all"
)

remaining_missing <- map_dfr(
  seq_along(completed_list),
  function(i) {
    tibble(
      imp = i,
      variable = names(completed_list[[i]]),
      n_missing = map_int(
        completed_list[[i]],
        ~ sum(is.na(.x))
      )
    )
  }
) %>%
  filter(n_missing > 0)

print(remaining_missing)

stopifnot(nrow(remaining_missing) == 0)
```

## 4. Convergence / chain mixing

```{r fig.width=11, fig.height=9}
plot(
  imp,
  c(
    "hinc",
    "livedhere",
    "hgowner",
    "smallspace",
    "east",
    "M_edu_level",
    "F_edu_level"
  )
)
```

Look for overlapping chains fluctuating around stable levels without sustained trends.

## 5. Build observed-versus-imputed diagnostic data

```{r}
make_imp_values <- function(var) {

  missing_rows <- which(is.na(dat[[var]]))

  map_dfr(
    seq_len(imp$m),
    function(i) {

      completed_i <- completed_list[[i]]
      raw_values <- completed_i[[var]][missing_rows]

      tibble(
        imp = i,
        row_id = missing_rows,
        value_chr = as.character(raw_values),
        value_num = suppressWarnings(
          as.numeric(as.character(raw_values))
        )
      )
    }
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      variable = var,
      .before = 1
    )
}

imputed_long <- map_dfr(
  target_vars,
  make_imp_values
)

stopifnot(
  sum(is.na(imputed_long$value_num)) == 0
)
```

## 6. PMM donor-support checks

```{r}
pmm_vars <- c("hinc", "livedhere")

pmm_support <- map_dfr(
  pmm_vars,
  function(v) {

    observed_values <- unique(
      as.numeric(dat[[v]][!is.na(dat[[v]])])
    )

    imputed_values <- imputed_long %>%
      filter(variable == v) %>%
      pull(value_num)

    tibble(
      variable = v,
      n_imputed = length(imputed_values),
      n_not_in_observed_support =
        sum(!(imputed_values %in% observed_values)),
      min_imputed = min(imputed_values),
      max_imputed = max(imputed_values)
    )
  }
)

print(pmm_support)

stopifnot(
  all(pmm_support$n_not_in_observed_support == 0)
)
```

## 7. Continuous-variable observed vs imputed summaries

```{r}
continuous_vars <- c("hinc", "livedhere")

continuous_summary <- map_dfr(
  continuous_vars,
  function(v) {

    observed <- as.numeric(
      dat[[v]][!is.na(dat[[v]])]
    )

    imputed <- imputed_long %>%
      filter(variable == v) %>%
      pull(value_num)

    bind_rows(
      tibble(
        variable = v,
        source = "Observed",
        n = length(observed),
        min = min(observed),
        q1 = quantile(observed, .25),
        median = median(observed),
        mean = mean(observed),
        q3 = quantile(observed, .75),
        max = max(observed)
      ),
      tibble(
        variable = v,
        source = "Imputed",
        n = length(imputed),
        min = min(imputed),
        q1 = quantile(imputed, .25),
        median = median(imputed),
        mean = mean(imputed),
        q3 = quantile(imputed, .75),
        max = max(imputed)
      )
    )
  }
)

print(continuous_summary)
```

## 9. PMM variation across imputations

```{r}
pmm_by_imp <- imputed_long %>%
  filter(variable %in% pmm_vars) %>%
  group_by(variable, imp) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    min = min(value_num),
    q1 = quantile(value_num, .25),
    median = median(value_num),
    mean = mean(value_num),
    q3 = quantile(value_num, .75),
    max = max(value_num),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(pmm_by_imp)
```

## 10. `livedhere` support

```{r}
livedhere_imp <- imputed_long %>%
  filter(variable == "livedhere")

livedhere_support <- livedhere_imp %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    min = min(value_num),
    max = max(value_num),
    n_negative = sum(value_num < 0),
    n_noninteger = sum(
      abs(value_num - round(value_num)) > 1e-8
    )
  )

print(livedhere_support)

stopifnot(
  livedhere_support$n_negative == 0,
  livedhere_support$n_noninteger == 0
)
```

## 11. Income support

```{r}
hinc_imp <- imputed_long %>%
  filter(variable == "hinc")

hinc_support <- hinc_imp %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    min = min(value_num),
    max = max(value_num),
    n_nonpositive = sum(value_num <= 0)
  )

print(hinc_support)

stopifnot(
  hinc_support$n_nonpositive == 0
)
```

## 12. Binary-variable observed vs imputed proportions

```{r}
binary_vars <- c(
  "hgowner",
  "smallspace",
  "east"
)

binary_summary <- map_dfr(
  binary_vars,
  function(v) {

    observed_num <- as.numeric(
      as.character(
        dat[[v]][!is.na(dat[[v]])]
      )
    )

    imputed_num <- imputed_long %>%
      filter(variable == v) %>%
      pull(value_num)

    tibble(
      variable = v,
      source = c("Observed", "Imputed"),
      n = c(length(observed_num), length(imputed_num)),
      prop_1 = c(
        mean(observed_num == 1),
        mean(imputed_num == 1)
      )
    )
  }
)

print(binary_summary)
```

## 13. Binary variation across imputations

```{r}
binary_by_imp <- imputed_long %>%
  filter(variable %in% binary_vars) %>%
  group_by(variable, imp) %>%
  summarise(
    prop_1 = mean(value_num == 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(binary_by_imp)
```

## 14. Education observed vs imputed distributions

```{r}
edu_vars <- c(
  "M_edu_level",
  "F_edu_level"
)

edu_summary <- map_dfr(
  edu_vars,
  function(v) {

    observed <- tibble(
      value = as.character(
        dat[[v]][!is.na(dat[[v]])]
      ),
      source = "Observed"
    )

    imputed <- imputed_long %>%
      filter(variable == v) %>%
      transmute(
        value = value_chr,
        source = "Imputed"
      )

    bind_rows(
      observed,
      imputed
    ) %>%
      count(source, value, name = "n") %>%
      group_by(source) %>%
      mutate(
        proportion = n / sum(n)
      ) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      mutate(
        variable = v,
        .before = 1
      )
  }
)

print(edu_summary)
```

## 15. Education variation across imputations

```{r}
edu_by_imp <- imputed_long %>%
  filter(variable %in% edu_vars) %>%
  count(
    variable,
    imp,
    value_chr,
    name = "n"
  ) %>%
  group_by(variable, imp) %>%
  mutate(
    proportion = n / sum(n)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

print(edu_by_imp)
```

## 17. Final automatic checks

```{r}
n_logged <- if (
  is.null(imp$loggedEvents)
) {
  0L
} else {
  nrow(imp$loggedEvents)
}

cat("\n====================================\n")
cat("06 FINAL MICE DIAGNOSTIC SUMMARY\n")
cat("====================================\n")
cat("Logged events:", n_logged, "\n")
cat(
  "Unexpected PMM donor values:",
  sum(pmm_support$n_not_in_observed_support),
  "\n"
)
cat(
  "Negative livedhere imputations:",
  livedhere_support$n_negative,
  "\n"
)
cat(
  "Noninteger livedhere imputations:",
  livedhere_support$n_noninteger,
  "\n"
)
cat(
  "Nonpositive income imputations:",
  hinc_support$n_nonpositive,
  "\n"
)
cat(
  "Remaining missing values:",
  nrow(remaining_missing),
  "\n"
)
cat("====================================\n")

stopifnot(
  n_logged == 0,
  sum(pmm_support$n_not_in_observed_support) == 0,
  livedhere_support$n_negative == 0,
  livedhere_support$n_noninteger == 0,
  hinc_support$n_nonpositive == 0,
  nrow(remaining_missing) == 0
)

cat(
  "\nPASS: all automatic integrity/support checks passed.\n",
  "Review the final trace and distribution plots before proceeding ",
  "to propensity-score estimation.\n"
)
```
